market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC spot ~$78,300 on May 2, 2026; reaching $45k requires a ~42% drawdown in 8 months without prior touch since Nov 24, 2025. Conservative analyst range floors at $60-75k; only deep-bear scenarios (>50% peak-to-trough) reach $45k. Possible in a recession/risk-off shock but historically uncommon mid-cycle.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or major regulatory/exchange event.
